method: Fresh semantic review of article content only; labels, discovery markers, production rankings and scores, quality metrics, and Git history were withheld from each adjudicator.

rubric.0: incidental or general overlap; not useful enough as a related article

rubric.2: same core problem and directly, strongly useful
